user.title: SmartThings access
user.description:
Create a Personal Access Token at {tokens_url} with the device list, read and execute scopes, then paste it below.

The token is used once to register an app and is never stored, so it does not matter that SmartThings expires tokens after 24 hours.

authorize.title: Authorize Home Assistant

error.invalid_token_format: That does not look like a SmartThings token (expected a 36-character UUID).
error.cannot_create_app: Could not register the SmartApp. Check the token is valid and has not expired.
error.no_code_found: No authorization code found in that URL. Paste the whole address, including the ?code= part.
error.exchange_failed: SmartThings rejected the authorization code. It may have already been used or expired; start again.

abort.no_compatible_devices: No air conditioners with display LED control were found on this account.
abort.already_configured: That air conditioner is already set up.
